# OARC Digital

> Malta's First Creative + AI Systems Agency — Where Creativity Meets Revenue.

OARC Digital is Malta's leading creative and AI agency, combining brand strategy, content production, influencer marketing, AI automation, and hospitality technology into one unified growth system. Based in Birkirkara, Malta. Founded by Sahan Reddy.

---

## Hospitality 360

Hospitality 360 is Malta's first all-in-one operating system for restaurants, cafes, and hotels.

Features:
- AI-powered digital menus in 9+ languages (for Malta's 2.3M annual tourists)
- QR code ordering and payment — faster table turnover, fewer errors
- Google review automation — guests prompted to leave a review before they leave
- Reservations and event bookings
- POS, invoicing, inventory management
- WhatsApp order automation
- Supplier and stock management
- Customer data, preferences, and follow-up automation

Pricing: from €100/month. No upfront cost.
Contact: +356 7971 1799 | hello@oarcdigital.com

---

## PJAZZA — Live Video Marketplace

PJAZZA is Malta's first live video marketplace, operating across multiple countries. Businesses go live on video to showcase products, menus, and experiences. Customers discover, watch, and buy in real time.

Launch: May 2026.
Built by Maltaverse (maltaverse.live).
